svg.title: MultiMind — multi-LLM ensemble pipeline flowchart
svg.desc: Flowchart: user question fans out to three parallel AI models, outputs converge at a disagreement detection stage, branch to fast path or cross-critique, merge into synthesis, and output a final answer with a confidence badge.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the MultiMind user question input stage')
sendPrompt('How does Llama 3 70B work in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('How does Gemini Flash work in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('How does Mistral 7B work in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('How does MultiMind detect disagreement between models?')
sendPrompt('What is the fast path in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('How does the cross-critique stage work in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('How does the synthesis stage work in MultiMind?')
sendPrompt('What confidence labels does MultiMind assign to final answers?')
